title: I used Codex and Godot 4 to build this gear evolution system for my idle RPG
author: Knuckleclot
selftext:
I've been working on Fellvault, a dark fantasy idle RPG I'm building with Godot 4 and Codex.

One of the systems I've spent a lot of time refining is equipment evolution.

Originally, evolving gear felt pretty underwhelming. It was mostly a rarity change with some basic effects.

I've since worked on adding a proper transformation sequence with energy buildup, shaking, a burst and a rarity reveal. Some feedback I got on Reddit actually helped me improve the timing.

Here's a clip showing all six equipment pieces evolving from Epic to Legendary.

The tricky part with AI-assisted development hasn't really been getting something working. It's getting the animations, UI and progression to actually feel polished.

For anyone else using AI to build games, how much manual iteration are you doing to get your animations looking right?
